channel.title: Ashish Tadigiri · Lab notes
channel.description: The news, then what to do about it.

item.title: The November 2026 core update ends days before Black Friday. Read it right.
item.description: The core update may run to 24 November. How to measure it with the holiday ramp taken out, a ±10% rule for what to do, and a calculator.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)

item.title: Micros are now half of CME's index futures volume. MNQ vs NQ: when to switch.
item.description: MNQ volume is up 74%. When to trade the micro, when the mini, and the split rule that keeps your risk and cuts your fees, with a calculator.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)

item.title: Your AI agent may be installing MCP servers nobody patches. Audit yours in 10 minutes.
item.description: Agents keep installing archived MCP servers with unpatched flaws. A 10-minute audit, a decision rule per server and a checker that reads your config.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)

item.title: Four unconfirmed Google spikes in 12 days. Triage your ranking drop in 10 minutes.
item.description: Four unconfirmed Google spikes in October. A formula that splits a click drop into impressions and CTR, a five-check triage and a tool that gives the next step.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)

item.title: CME just logged its busiest Q3 ever. Run this 7-point backtest checklist before you trust yours.
item.description: Seven backtest checks with pass marks, a worked MNQ example and a calculator that shows the Sharpe you need after counting every variation you tested.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)

item.title: Bulenox cut its 100K drawdown by $1,000. Re-size before your next trade.
item.description: Bulenox cut Momentum drawdowns and Lucid moved consistency to 40%. The sizing formula, a daily stop-win rule and a calculator to re-size tonight.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)

item.title: Microsoft says treat AI agents as insiders. Give yours four permission tiers.
item.description: Microsoft says every AI agent needs its own identity, zero standing access and human approval for high-impact actions. A four-tier model and planner to apply it.
item.author: info@ashishtadigiri.in (Ashish Tadigiri)
